profile.headline: Founding Engineer at Immunera
profile.summary: Cinematographer -> software developer -> technical product manager -> software consultancy == sharp eye for design and unending pursuit of the ideal user experience. Learner. Experimenter. Creator.

positions.title: Principal Software Engineer
positions.locationName: Brooklyn, New York, United States · On-site
positions.description:
We specialize in crafting scalable, maintainable, and innovative tech solutions to address real-world business challenges. By leveraging the latest in AI and modern software technologies, we help businesses turn their vision into reality.

With over a decade of experience, I’ve developed products for industry leaders like Spotify, Afresh, and Butterfly Network. My expertise lies in bridging the gap between business needs and technical solutions, rapidly transforming ideas into production-ready software for web and mobile platforms.

If you’re looking for a partner to bring your ideas to life with cutting-edge technology, let’s connect.
positions.insights: Skills: Artificial Intelligence (AI) · Web Development · Mobile Application Development

positions.title: Head of Quality & Productivity
positions.description:
Butterfly Network is reinventing medical imaging and championing a new era of healthcare by creating the world’s first ultrasound-on-a-chip. This groundbreaking semiconductor technology replaces expensive and bulky Ultrasound carts with a pocket-sized, full body scanning device.

Deep Learning models assist physicians and patients in acquiring and interpreting diagnostic images, dramatically widening the usability of ultrasound. Our mobile-first user experience and native cloud architecture allows for real-time patient insights directly to your phone & seamless clinical collaboration. Together, this modern-era technology will democratize healthcare for 40 million physicians and billions of people worldwide.

Joining Butterfly Network is the opportunity to redesign the future of medicine. Embark on a journey with us to maximize global impact and save the lives of the ones you love. 

Help build our cutting-edge technology platform! Full Stack Cloud Engineers, iOS and Android Developers, DevOps Engineers, Research Scientists, Security Engineers, and other specialists are invited to apply. 

Visit our careers page to find the right role for you!
https://butterflynetwork.com/careers

patents.title: Vehicle detection for media content player connected to vehicle media content player
patents.description: A system for automatically initiating a travel mode of a media playback device is disclosed. The system operates to determine that the media playback device is connected to a vehicle media playback system based on an identifier provided from the vehicle media playback system. Upon determining presence of the media playback device in a vehicle, the travel mode is performed using the media playback device.
